module: Core of the crawl mode (slow trail traversal) on the freeroam/career side: keeps the active trail (activeTrail: trail, zone, copied path, start, prefabs) and the list of crawler data, prepares a trail (setupCrawl, with optional path reversal), starts the crawl in freeroam or from a flowgraph, and calls gameplay_crawl_utils.updateCrawl every frame. It also provides the points of interest (start markers, map), the activity windows, the drawing of the zone on the minimap, and records the scores at the end. It handles the local multiplayer case (multiseat).
notes: Only one active trail at a time (M.activeTrail). If trail.pathReversed is true, the path is copied, reversed and each rotation is turned by 180 degrees around Z; the starting position becomes trail.startingPositionIdReversed, or the first reversed node (radius 10 m).
Trails appear in the game only if career is active or if the enableCrawlInFreeroam setting is true (onGetRawPoiListForLevel).
In multiseat, entering the start zone automatically starts the crawl, unless a multiseat game mode is active or the trails differ.
M.crawlersData and its local copy point to the same table; clear empties it with table.clear, so the variable must not be reassigned.
When a vehicle is changed or destroyed in freeroam (trail not from a mission), its crawler is cleaned up; the trail is cleared when no crawler exists anymore.
onCrawlResultsShown records the score (time, points) via saveSystem.addNewPlayerScore.

dependencies.desc: Extensions loaded beforehand: gameplay_crawl_saveSystem, utils, boundary, display.

activeTrail.desc: Active trail: {trail, boundary, path, startingPosition, prefabs, isFromMission}; nil if none.

crawlersData.desc: List of crawler data (created by gameplay_crawl_utils.setupCrawlerData) of the active trail.

clear.desc: Unloads the prefabs of the active trail, forgets the trail, cleans up gameplay_crawl_utils and empties crawlersData.

setupCrawl.desc: Prepares a trail: stops the previous crawl, resolves zone, path and start from saveSystem, handles reversal, creates the crawler data, loads the prefabs and, if isFromMission, teleports the vehicle to the starting position.

trail.desc: Trail (boundaryId, pathId, startingPositionId, pathReversed, prefabs, name).

isFromMission.desc: True if started by a mission/flowgraph.

returns.desc: false if zone or path are missing or if trail/veh is nil.

startCrawlFreeroam.desc: Starts a crawl in freeroam. In multiseat with the same trail already active, simply adds the vehicle to the crawl; otherwise prepares the trail then calls gameplay_crawl_utils.startCrawl, emits onCrawlStarted and clears the raw POIs.

startCrawlFlowgraph.desc: Starts a crawl from a flowgraph. If the same trail (same name) is already prepared, reuses it; otherwise calls setupCrawl(trail, veh, true). Emits onCrawlStarted.

onUpdate.desc: Hook called every frame: advances the active crawl (gameplay_crawl_utils.updateCrawl).

onGetRawPoiListForLevel.desc: Hook collecting the points of interest of a level: for each trail (folder /levels/<level>/crawls/) adds a 'crawl' type POI with an invisible trigger, a start marker and a map marker (name, thumbnail, best points) as long as no trail is active.

onActivityAcceptGatherData.desc: Activity window hook: for a 'crawl' POI, adds a card (distance, positive/negative elevation change, best points, best time, attempts) and a "Play" button that runs startCrawlFreeroam on the player's vehicle.

onActivityIndexVisible.desc: Hook called when an activity is shown/hidden in the index: prepares the trail and its path markers for a crawl POI, or cleans up if data is nil.

data.desc: POI data (type, trailId); nil when the index closes.

onDrawOnMinimap.desc: Hook called to draw on the minimap: draws the zone of the active trail.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook called on load: cleans up the state and creates the player's save folders.

onSerialize.desc: Hook called before extensions reload: cleans up the state.

onMPSessionChanged.desc: Hook called on multiplayer session change: loads gameplay_crawl_freeroamMultiplayer at session start and unloads it at the end.

onVehicleSwitched.desc: Hook called when the controlled vehicle changes: removes the crawler from the old vehicle (non-mission trail) and cleans up if none remain.

onVehicleDestroyed.desc: Hook called when a vehicle is destroyed: removes its crawler (non-mission trail).

onAnyMissionChanged.desc: Hook called when a mission's state changes: cleans everything up if it goes to 'stopped'.

onCrawlCleared.desc: Hook emitted by utils.clear() at the end of each crawl: empties crawlersData and clears the raw POIs to show the start marker again.

onCrawlResultsShown.desc: Hook called when the results are shown: records the player's time and points for the active trail.
